audibility.label: Audibility rings
audibility.note: A ring around each player showing how far their movement carries. It is the largest mark on the plate, and it is an approximation of the game's own falloff.

scoreboard.label: Scoreboard position
scoreboard.note: On the timeline it costs the plate nothing. Over the map it floats above the players, which is the one thing allowed to cover them.

debug.label: Debug overlay
debug.note: Map, frame, drawn level, and the world coordinate under the pointer. Built for working on the tool rather than on a match.
